description:
We are ShiftScale, a team of passionate innovators interested in AI, machine learning, software development and data science. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are building ShiftScale, a platform that uses NASA Earth-observation data to support smarter farming decisions in Ghana. We welcome members interested in Python, remote sensing, agriculture, data analysis, UI/UX design and research. We value teamwork, creativity and continuous learning.

ShiftScale — Think Beyond. Build Bigger!..
summary: ShiftScale is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform that uses NASA Earth observation data, local soil information, and farmer-specific details to generate personalized crop rotation recommendations. It helps Ghanaian smallholder farmers improve soil health, conserve water, adapt to changing climate conditions, and make informed farming decisions for more resilient and sustainable agriculture.
details:
ShiftScale helps Ghanaian smallholder farmers decide what to plant next, and and why they have to plant those crops.

Farmers tell us about their land: location, size, soil type, current and previous crops, water access, and priorities.

We combine this with NASA satellite data, temperature from NASA POWER and rainfall from GPM IMERG, then use Python and machine learning to recommend rotations that suit their specific farm.

The result is plain-language advice that improves soil health, saves water, and builds resilience to changing weather.

We designed it for farmers with limited literacy or digital experience, using simple navigation and visuals. We also clearly separate satellite estimates from lab soil tests.

Our goal is to turn NASA data into everyday farming decisions.
